limitations: One representative direct identity per family; family internals remain covered by matrix and compiler tests.
VNet peering is emitted only from an explicit remote virtual network reference.
Producer, consumer, backend, secret-use, VPN, and ExpressRoute relations remain absent because provider references alone do not prove those architecture facts.
Only exact literal ARM type and API-version values match; generic body evidence emits no facts.
Unapproved generic AzAPI overlap and patch resources never duplicate the typed AzureRM owner.
AzAPI body and literal parent resource ID remain outside Architecture IR and HTML.
